name: krea
description: Use Krea's creative AI suite to generate, edit, enhance, animate, and produce visual work across Krea models.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, enhance, and edit images and videos with Krea.
interface.longDescription: This plugin turns Codex into an open-ended Krea creative agent: describe what you want to make, improve, restyle, animate, upscale, adapt for marketing, or turn into a production workflow, and the agent routes the task through the right Krea surface and available models. Use it for quick image and video generation, generative editing, realtime exploration, high-resolution enhancement, LoRA/custom model workflows, product and campaign creative, architecture and interior visualization, storyboards, animation planning, multi-step creative production, and more.
defaultPrompt: Generate 20 variations of my product in different studio backgrounds and angles
Make a storyboard based on this character and script, then animate it
Upscale this image with your top 5 enhancers and let me compare the results
